description: This file defines the interface for the FocusManager class within the Testing namespace. It provides method signatures for starting and stopping the focus manager, including a singleton instance accessor, and a virtual destructor. The class is meant to be subclassed with concrete implementations.

classes.name: FocusManager
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a focus management interface used in testing scenarios. Implements singleton pattern access via Instance(), declares pure virtual methods Start() and Stop(), and has a protected constructor to prevent direct instantiation.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FocusManager.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Pure virtual method to start the focus manager; should be implemented in derived classes.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Pure virtual method to stop the focus manager; should be implemented in derived classes.
